# ESE Seal

ESE Seal is a Springfield, Missouri masonry repair, concrete repair and water-entry protection company owned by Eric Enlow. The company is owner-led and focused on protecting homes and businesses from water intrusion, cracked masonry and concrete deterioration.

## Primary services
- Masonry repair for brick, stone and block
- Tuckpointing (mortar joint restoration)
- Chimney and fireplace masonry repair
- Foundation and poured concrete wall crack repair
- Waterproofing / water-entry point repair
- Concrete flatwork, steps and porch repair
- Exterior caulking and sealing (additional listing, ask for details)

## Service area
ESE Seal is based in Springfield, Missouri and serves homeowners and businesses within roughly a 60-mile radius, including Nixa, Ozark, Republic, Battlefield, Willard, Rogersville, Bolivar, Branson, Hollister and dozens of surrounding Southwest Missouri communities.
